items.title: Hormel names its new CEO
items.summary: Jul. 28—AUSTIN, Minn. — Hormel Foods Corp., a southern Minnesota Fortune 500 company known as the maker of Spam, announced a new leader to replace the interim CEO of the past year. Hormel's Board of Directors have appointed John Ghingo as president and chief executive officer. His tenure will start on Oct. 26. items.title: Hormel Foods Appoints John Ghingo as Chief Executive Officer
items.summary: Hormel Foods Corporation (NYSE:HRL) has named John Ghingo as its next president and chief executive officer, with his appointment set to take effect on 26 October 2026. Ghingo will succeed Jeff Ettinger, who has led the company as interim chief executive during the board’s search for a permanent successor.
